goal: Test independent upper and lower head anatomy driven by the existing HD armature and actions

parameters.source_bounds: Measured BMD jaw island and inherited HD head

steps: Created independent maxilla and mandible lofts, simple teeth, eyes, brows and nostrils.
Bound the upper anatomy to Bip01 Head and the mandible to Bone02 on the inherited armature.
Rendered side and front views at idle and attack actions 3/4, frames 0 and 3.
observations: The jaw opens in sampled attack poses without the previous cheek tear, but a later all-action sweep found tip crossings at intermediate frames.
The head is an isolated graybox with a smooth generic profile, crude eyes and teeth, no neck graft or production mouth tissues.
Do not promote this study to asset v0002 or export it as a finished dragon.

checks.name: animated separation without tear in sampled attack pose
no mouth intersection across all seven actions
body graft, UV, PBR, LOD and export
